page.title: Filming kit · Skin consultations
page.eyebrow: Skin consultations · prepared for Clinic A · 2026
page.h1: Five ads to film on a phone.
page.lead: Each one is 20 to 45 seconds, one take, on a phone. The words are written out in full.
howto: Pick an ad from the row at the top and read the script.
Say it in your own rhythm, one line at a time.
Name the file as shown, upload it, tick it off.
page.recipe: Speak to one person · about one concern · with one clear offer · send them to a quick form.
page.hook_rule: The first 3 seconds decide everything. Call out the person · name the problem · drop the number · make an invitation · take the blame off them.
rules_chips: Face a window, not a light
before_filming: Confirm the offer price with us before ad 1 is filmed.
page.research_intro: We looked at the ads running right now in your market and picked the ones that sell your kind of offer to your kind of customer.
never_survives: Technical explainers about how the machine works.
Silent footage with music. Every strong example talks to the viewer.
page.open_lanes: Payment-plan framing, ads for men, seasonal moments.
page.compliance_note: Everything above sticks to what is safe to say in your market: no testimonials about outcomes, no before-and-after promises, no prescription medicines named.
page.next_step: On the call we'll choose which to record first and agree the offer. We handle captions, copy, targeting and launch.

key_things.text: A person speaks to camera inside the first second.

insights: Says her name and the clinic inside three seconds, so it reads as a person, not an ad.
The offer is said once, at the end, and never repeated.
winners.why: A person, one concern, one offer.

patterns.what: A person speaks to camera in the first second

scripts.title: The personal invite
scripts.hook: Hi, I'm Alex from Clinic A, and I want to invite you in for a free skin consultation.
body: We'll look at what's going on with your skin and tell you honestly what will help.
scripts.close: Tap below and fill in the quick form, and we'll be in touch to book you in.
scripts.lands_on: Instant lead form (name, mobile, best time)
scripts.good: Alex in the treatment room, name in the first two seconds, the offer said once, under 35 seconds.
scripts.shot: Straight to camera, phone at eye height, facing a window.
scripts.ref_format: Talking head, phone, clinic room, burned-in captions
ref_insights: She says her name and the clinic inside three seconds, so it reads as a person, not an ad.
One promise, one offer, one tap.
Take the pace and the framing. The words are already written for you.
